RR.type: Nonpreemptive work-conserving task-queue cyclic dispatcher, NOT operating-system time-quantum SCHED_RR
RR.quantum: one admitted request, not CPU time
RR.within_queue: earliest arrival then ordinal among physically executable ready requests
RR.skip: Skip a queue if it has no physically executable request, never idle while another queue can execute
RR.pointer: After dispatch point to the other task queue; after NONE retain current pointer

OURS: Original frozen881087 rolling+ATC+publicBC+PPO argmax, no deadline protection; no new forward, training or environment
comparison: Whole policy comparison with common plant/input/stream/window/legal routes/CPU3/nonpreemption. RR alternates dispatch opportunities rather than equalizing CPU seconds. Classification is urgent and detection normal in this source cohort.
figures: Show absolute metrics and EDF-referenced differences with units, positive/negative effects, zero reference, stated zoomed dot axes, all4 paired inputs. No invented significance or best-case selection.
